exposure: Women were divided into three age groups: younger than 16 years old, 16-19 years old, and 20-34 years old.
cohort: Women with singleton pregnancies at a public hospital in Mexico (n = 957).
finding: While the frequency of maternal and perinatal complications was similar between adolescent and mature women,  birth weight was lower in noncomplicated pregnancies of adolescents younger than 16 years of age.
birth_weight: birth weight was lower for mothers <16 in uncomplicated pregnancies
